grain: one row per (ticker, concept, unit, end_date, form, accn) -- a filer can restate the same concept/period across multiple filings (10-Q, 10-K, 10-K/A); all restatements are kept, not deduplicated to 'latest'
source: SEC EDGAR XBRL company-facts API (data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts), us-gaap taxonomy only

concept.description: us-gaap XBRL tag, restricted to alpha_desk.data.sources.XBRL_CONCEPTS

unit.description: XBRL unit, typically USD or USD/shares or shares

end_date.description: Period end date for this observation

start_date.description: Period start date; null for instant (balance-sheet) concepts like Assets

fy.description: Fiscal year as tagged by the filer

fp.description: Fiscal period (Q1/Q2/Q3/FY) as tagged by the filer

filed.description: Date the filing hit EDGAR -- the correct timestamp for point-in-time backtests, NOT end_date

accn.description: SEC accession number identifying the exact filing

invariants: concept is one of the 8 XBRL_CONCEPTS extracted, not the full company-facts payload
filed >= end_date always (a filing cannot predate the period it reports on)
a signal model MUST join on `filed`, not `end_date`, to avoid look-ahead bias -- see docs/DATA_BACKBONE.md
